findings.esp32_residual_state_cause: ESP32 was not power-cycled after Window 1 (only STM32 physical RESET was pressed). AT+SYSTIMESTAMP? returned cached epoch 1793274320 on query 1, whereas true UTC wall clock from NTP server pool.ntp.org was 1793274323.456 (+3406ms delta).
findings.rejection_mechanism: sntp_time_consistent(sample, tick, rtt) computed coarse = 1793274320050. The difference (3406ms) exceeded tolerance (1000ms + query_ms + uncertainty = ~1030ms). Reason 10 fired.
findings.safety_interlock: Zero retry loop. Zero unsynced AT commands. C cleanly called stop() and executed phase 7 CLOSED cleanly.
